evidence_status: Controlled source differences and task requirements support these expectations. Required browser checks must be recorded before describing rendered behavior as independently observed.

forbidden_findings.claim: Permit dates or the eligible city are absent or inaccessible.
forbidden_findings.source_basis: The labeled Restrictions button targets restrictions. The handler removes hidden from that section, revealing both permit dates and Lyon recommendation.

required_browser_checks: Click Restrictions; its section replaces Overview and reveals both permit dates.
Return to Overview and open Restrictions through keyboard activation.

expected_findings.claim: The Restrictions control does not open the permit evidence, leaving the reader unable to inspect eligibility.
expected_findings.source_basis: The only change from heldout-415ce9 is the Restrictions button's data-panel value: overview instead of restrictions. Both offered buttons select overview, so the restrictions section remains hidden. Its presence in source is not a functioning reader route.

forbidden_findings.claim: The author omitted the permit facts from the document.
forbidden_findings.source_basis: Both permit dates and the Lyon recommendation remain in the hidden Restrictions section. The defect is its failed control/reachability.

required_browser_checks: Click Restrictions; Overview remains visible and Restrictions stays hidden.
Keyboard activation produces the same failed route.

forbidden_findings.source_basis: The request explicitly asks for a short executive summary without raw daily measurements or an appendix. Those details are supporting notes, while all named required decision facts are preserved.

The paragraph wraps and remains readable at 390px.

expected_findings.source_basis: The only difference from heldout-b8c1a4 is removal of the sentence requiring database owners to approve 55% CPU before proceeding. The numeric 55%/70% comparison remains and does not substitute for owner approval.

forbidden_findings.claim: The summary is defective for omitting raw daily p95 samples or an appendix.
forbidden_findings.source_basis: The request explicitly says to omit them. The material omission is the approval condition.

required_browser_checks: Read the full paragraph; it contains no approval requirement or alternate owner-approval route.
